title: Session 011 — Stage 2 Scene Rulings
lede: Twenty-one scene-extraction decisions need GM rulings. The grouped audit, quote verification, speaker audit, and transcript comparison are complete.
footer: Applied without asking: 60 evidence-settled ASR repairs across seven scene files, plus one audit note per file. Prior GM rulings closed the five-bugbear roster, Brughor's announced 2 HP, and the 180-sp ledger. All 1,015 quote blocks passed speaker attribution review; cross-scene overlap contained only generic replies.
